title: ASSEMBLY OF TRANSMISSION CASE AND REAR BRAKE PISTONS

content.description: Installation of O-rings on reaction sleeve and pistons, showing thinner and thicker O-ring placement

items.heading: INSTALL NEW O-RINGS ON REACTION SLEEVE AND PISTONS

caution.text: The thinner O-ring goes on the outside of the reaction sleeve.

items.heading: INSTALL INNER AND OUTER PISTONS IN REACTION SLEEVE

substeps.label: (a)
substeps.text: Push the inner piston into the cupped side of the reaction sleeve.

substeps.label: (b)
substeps.text: Push the outer piston onto the other side of the reaction sleeve.

content.description: Cross-section view of pistons installed in reaction sleeve with label AT0197

items.heading: INSTALL PISTONS AND SLEEVE IN CASE

caution.text: Be careful not to damage the O-rings.

items.text: Hold the assembly with the outer piston upward (spring seats visible), and push the assembly into its bore in the case.

content.description: Top view showing sixteen piston return springs arranged in circular pattern with label C4071

items.heading: INSTALL SIXTEEN PISTON RETURN SPRINGS AND SET RETAINER WITH SNAP RING IN PLACE

notice.text: The springs are visible through the cutout in the case, which helps position them more easily.

content.description: Cross-section diagram showing SST tool compressing piston return springs with label Z2114

items.heading: COMPRESS PISTON RETURN SPRINGS TO ALLOW INSTALLATION OF SNAP RING

caution.text: Do not overtighten the bolt and bend the spring retainer.

substeps.label: (a)
substeps.text: Carefully position the spring compressor on the spring retainer.

substeps.label: (b)
substeps.text: Gradually and evenly tighten the bolt to compress the springs, being careful not to damage the transmission case with SST.

content.description: Top and side view showing snap ring installation on spring retainer with SST tool, labeled AT0630-AT0631

substeps.label: (a)
substeps.text: Snap the ring into place with your fingers. Visually check to make sure it is fully seated and centered by the three lugs on the spring retainer.

items.heading: KEEP MANUAL VALVE LEVER, PARKING LOCK PAWL AND ACCUMULATOR
